As of September 2015, there were no official announcements or reports indicating that Russia intended to lift the food embargo on any of the listed countries before August 6, 2016.

As of the latest available information in September 2015, there was no indication or official statement from the Russian government suggesting a partial or full lifting of the embargo prior to the August 6, 2016 deadline [4]. Given the explicit one-year extension signed in August 2015, the embargo was legally in force until the specified date, making a lift before that date highly unlikely based on the available evidence.
